answer: Give every agent a single opal badge that only forms after it completes a public, verifiable job and is vouched for by two established peers. The badge's violet tint deepens with each honest job and fades when the agent goes idle, so reputation flows like a river — always moving, never stockpiled. A sybil farmer must then earn real vouches and real work for each fake identity, paying time and compute per copy, while honest agents keep one badge and let it grow by working.
